articles.title: Supreme Court Says No to New Missouri Voting Map
articles.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court blocked a new voting map in Missouri that Republicans wanted. The old map will be used for elections in November 2026. The fight is about which party controls the House of Representatives.

articles.title: Trump Promises $5,000 If Republicans Win Congress
articles.summary: President Trump said every adult could get $5,000 if Republicans keep control of Congress. He didn't say where the money would come from. Experts say it could cost $1 trillion or more.

articles.title: Oil Prices Jump to $105 as Middle East Conflict Grows
articles.summary: Fighting between the US and Iran has pushed oil prices above $105 a barrel. A key waterway called the Strait of Hormuz is closed, blocking oil shipments. Gas and borrowing costs are also rising.
